limits: Diagnostic Start and demo_estate replace normal flow only in disposable copies.
Actual next_day job payload and end_day_screen scene branches execute in the installed native QSP engine.
display_pic is replaced only in diagnostic copies to observe requested actor and action; image content and GUI layout are not visually checked.
State is primed from a save as assignments; no actual save loading or writing is performed.
Tie probes accept either highest-skilled checked eligible actor; they do not statistically prove uniform randomness.
